name: Ladders, Reset
tagline: Lamps and Ladders typeset again and nothing else: Azeret Mono for the machine and its figures, true small caps for every legend, and every marker hung outside the text edge.
concept: Lamps and Ladders with only its type reset, so the panel can see what typesetting alone does. The machine off the glass now speaks in Azeret Mono, a wide teleprinter mono (figures, dates, times, ids, stamps, the wordmark), set a step lighter than Plex Mono was and a size down inside Plex text, its zero slashed where a figure stands alone. Every legend (the rail's labels, field labels, column heads, kinds, states, the lamp key, the log's call signs, the case's engraving) is set in Barlow Condensed's true small caps, the one library sans that cuts smcp and c2sc, like words engraved on a panel; the glass keeps VT323's own capitals. Markers hang: the amber bar before Late, setup's step numbers, the lamp key's first lamp, the lamp before Ready, the tube's > prompt, disclosure chevrons, list bullets and numbered steps sit in the margin so the words keep one edge; on the phone's 16px margins they come back inside. Colours, layout, light and words are the parent's.
companions: Slate (#111716) for every bay under one 2px top rule. Steel (#6f8596 with a #a9c4d8 cap) for 'here', today, the waiting dot and the family's side of the log. Pewter rings for off, and for a plan already flown. Amber (#e3a651) only for needs a look and late, as a bar, an edge or words, never a surface. Violet (#a191bd) only as solid flight-plan lines and stop rings. Matte kind swatches.
